title: Achieving Near-Zero-Overhead Multi-Model Hierarchical Classification in Real-Time Detection Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2608.11770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Edge-deployed vision systems in target recognition, surveillance, autonomous vehicles, and drone domains require hierarchical inference pipelines where a detection model identifies objects of interest and downstream classifiers provide fine-grained attribute analysis. Running all models on the GPU creates a serial bottleneck that limits real-time throughput as pipeline stages grow. Modern edge SoCs pair GPUs with dedicated neural accelerators (NPUs, DLAs) capable of concurrent execution, yet deploying custom models on these accelerators remains impractical due to strict operator constraints, quantization incompatibilities, and an undocumented end-to-end pipeline. We target NVIDIA Jetson DLA cores as the representative platform. translated_title: 在实时检测流程中实现近零开销的多模型层次分类
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11770v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在目标识别、监控、自动驾驶和无人机领域的边缘部署视觉系统需要层次化推理流程，其中检测模型识别感兴趣的对象，下游分类器提供细粒度的属性分析。在GPU上运行所有模型会造成串行瓶颈，随着流程阶段增多，限制了实时吞吐量。现代边缘SoC将GPU与专用神经加速器（NPU、DLA）配对，支持并发执行，但由于严格的算子约束、量化不兼容性以及未文档化的端到端流程，在这些加速器上部署自定义模型仍不切实际。我们以NVIDIA Jetson DLA核心作为代表性平台。我们提出了一种五步方法论，用于分类骨干网络的零GPU回退DLA INT8部署，包括架构适配、手动动态范围规避以挽救TensorRT的隐式量化。
tldr: 本文提出一种五步方法论，实现分类骨干网络在NVIDIA Jetson DLA核心上的零GPU回退INT8部署，通过架构适配和手动动态范围调整，在实时检测流程中实现近零开销的多模型层次分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a five-step methodology for zero-GPU-fallback INT8 deployment of classification backbones on NVIDIA Jetson DLA cores, achieving near-zero-overhead multi-model hierarchical classification in real-time detection pipelines through architecture adaptation and manual dynamic range workarounds.
